cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI +2.04% · Brent -3.02% · NatGas +12.31%. 60% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.15%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.15%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -1.77%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ENPH is the standout at -16.16%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +12.68%, PWR +7.46%, EOSE +6.59%, ARRY +4.72%, NXT +4.17%. Laggards: ENPH -16.16%, SEDG -8.96%, BKR -6.27%, NOV -6.23%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.50% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
